verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a legacy-user-migration mechanism (import mode on custom DB connections lets users log in and be migrated gradually without a forced password reset, plus bulk import/export tooling), which directly supports moving off a competing provider without resetting passwords. However, the evidence is generic product documentation, not a named, vendor-maintained guide tailored to specific competing providers (e.g., Cognito, Firebase) and there's no hands-on/independent confirmation of the migration flow working smoothly. Missing for 10: competitor-specific migration guides, independent/hands-on validation of a no-reset migration, and detail on edge cases (MFA/social accounts) during migration.
